prompt: The client wants to know which customer segment to prioritize for growth. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Small business counts the most customers, 10,000
options.feedback: True, but at $500 each they bring in $5M, less than mid-market's $8M.

options.text: Enterprise brings in the most per customer, $100,000
options.feedback: True, but enterprise has only 50 customers ($5M in total) and is shrinking 5% a year.

options.text: Small business and mid-market add the same revenue each year
options.feedback: Both grow 20%, but from different bases: 20% of $5M is $1M; 20% of $8M is $1.6M.

options.text: Mid-market earns the most and adds the most growth
options.feedback: Right. Revenue: small business $5M, mid-market $8M, enterprise $5M. At 20% growth, mid-market adds $1.6M a year.

explanation: Revenue: small business $5M, mid-market $8M, enterprise $5M. At 20% growth, mid-market adds $1.6M a year against $1M for small business; enterprise shrinks.

extras.proof: Revenue: small business $5M, mid-market $8M, enterprise $5M. At 20% growth, mid-market adds $1.6M a year against $1M for small business; enterprise shrinks.
